title: AtSpi2Adapter._extract_bounds crashes on (-1,-1,-1,-1) extents
repro_steps: Subprocess in TC-E-005 yields top-level accessible with extents (-1,-1,-1,-1), causing Pydantic ValidationError on negative width/height in UiBounds

title: Docs usability gaps from blind-tester TC-E-006
repro_steps: Blind usability test found ambiguous batch field names (value vs text), missing scan output syntax, missing workflow parameterization example, unexplained jargon, and omitted Linux/Python prerequisites

title: AtSpi2Adapter dropdown select ignores nested menu items in GTK3 ComboBox
repro_steps: In TC-E-005 Gtk.ComboBoxText child 0 has role menu whose children are menu items; select_dropdown fails to traverse nested menu children

title: Workflow SafetyGuardrail and ControlDisabledError bypass via coordinate_fallback
repro_steps: Workflow step with non-matching target and coordinate_fallback skips guardrail checks and clicks fallback coordinates directly

title: Destructive keyboard shortcuts bypass SafetyGuardrail in press_shortcut
repro_steps: press_shortcut ignores CONFIRM tier shortcuts such as Alt+F4, Ctrl+Q, Shift+Delete

title: CONFIRM guardrail bypassed on non-click actions and arbitrary raw-coordinate clicks in draw_or_drag_path
repro_steps: Mutating actions hardcode confirmed=True and draw_or_drag_path with normalized=False accepts unconstrained raw screen coordinates

title: execute_action_batch accepts caller-supplied confirmed=True without server-side verification
repro_steps: Caller JSON confirmed=True is accepted directly in batch execution allowing unprompted destructive steps

title: Symlink traversal vulnerability in ToolSpecCache disk operations
repro_steps: Cache operations save_tool_spec, get_tool_spec, and delete do not reject symlinks or enforce path containment within cache_dir

title: UI label prompt injection in CompactControl and control_id collision on identical names
repro_steps: Unsanitized UI labels with newlines/ANSI escape codes leak into LLM context and duplicate control names cause internal_registry collisions
